# Gizmo AI Unlimited

> A free, open-source browser extension for unlimited hearts and unlocked hints on Gizmo AI quizzes, plus unlimited Magic Imports on app.gizmo.ai. It removes Magic Import's client-side cooldown without bypassing server-side limits.

## What it does
- Removes the "out of hearts" modal on app.gizmo.ai/quiz so practice is unlimited.
- Unlocks hints on standard Gizmo AI quiz questions
- Enables unlimited Magic Imports by disabling the client-side cooldown check; any server-side limits remain outside the extension's scope.
- Activates automatically when Gizmo opens; no separate extension account, settings, or setup.

## Key facts
- Price: Free, forever. No paid tier.
- Privacy: Zero personal data collected. No cookies, localStorage, analytics, or telemetry. All patching happens locally in the browser.
- Open source: Full source on GitHub at https://github.com/alexey-max-fedorov/gizmo-ai-unlimited
- Self-healing: Patch rules refresh every 2 hours, so it keeps working after Gizmo updates.
- Browsers: Firefox (Mozilla Add-ons), plus Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Brave via manual install.
- Not affiliated with Gizmo AI.

## Install
- Chrome / Brave: temporarily unavailable on the Chrome Web Store. Manual install of v2.2.0: https://github.com/alexey-max-fedorov/gizmo-ai-unlimited/releases/tag/v2.2.0 — see https://gizmo.best/get
- Microsoft Edge: temporarily unavailable on Microsoft Edge Add-ons. Manual install of v2.2.0 (load unpacked at edge://extensions): https://github.com/alexey-max-fedorov/gizmo-ai-unlimited/releases/tag/v2.2.0 — see https://gizmo.best/get
- Firefox: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/gizmo-ai-unlimited/
